item.title: Self-Hosted Password Management: Why I Switched to Vaultwarden
item.description: I got tired of paying for a password manager I didn't fully trust. Vaultwarden gives me everything Bitwarden offers — running on my own hardware, for free.

item.title: LXC Containers vs. Docker vs. Full VMs in Proxmox: What I Actually Use and Why
item.description: LXC containers, Docker, full VMs — Proxmox supports all three. Here's how I decide which one to use for each service in my homelab, and why it matters.

item.title: Cloudflare Tunnels: Self-Host Without Opening a Single Port
item.description: Cloudflare Tunnels let you expose self-hosted services to the internet without port forwarding, a public IP, or putting your home network at risk. Here's how they work and how to set one up.

item.title: Uptime Kuma: Self-Hosted Monitoring That Actually Looks Good
item.description: Uptime Kuma is the easiest way to monitor your self-hosted services and get notified when something goes down. Here's how to set it up in Docker and make it useful.

item.title: How to Start a Homelab in 2026 (Without Spending a Fortune)
item.description: A practical guide to building your first homelab in 2026 - what hardware to buy, what to skip, and how to get running without blowing your budget.

item.title: Self-Host Your First 5 Services with Docker Compose
item.description: Stop paying for services you can run yourself. Here are 5 genuinely useful self-hosted apps you can get running in an afternoon with Docker Compose.
